bib.title: Multimodal Few-Shot Learning with Frozen Language Models

question: Can a frozen text-only pre-trained language model be given a trained vision front-end so that its few-shot, in-context learning ability transfers to multimodal tasks?
hypothesis: Training only a vision encoder through a frozen LM on captioning will transfer the LM's rapid task adaptation, encyclopedic knowledge and fast concept binding to multimodal settings.
contributions: Frozen: a modular, scalable, efficient approach to training vision front-ends for large language models, handling interleaved image and text input
Show transfer of rapid task adaptation, encyclopedic knowledge and fast concept binding from language-only to multimodal, and that visual+language prompting beats language-only
Quantify these on existing and new benchmarks

method.summary: A 7B GPT-2-style LM is kept frozen. An NF-ResNet-50 vision encoder with a linear map emits a 2-token visual prefix per image and is trained by captioning loss on Conceptual Captions, with gradients flowing through the frozen LM. At test time images and text are interleaved in the prompt for VQA, OKVQA and few-shot classification.
method.task: image captioning pretraining; evaluated zero/few-shot on VQAv2, OKVQA, miniImageNet variants, Fast-VQA

datasets.name: Conceptual Captions
datasets.preprocessing: 224x224 images; non-square padded with zeros to square then resized

datasets.name: VQAv2
datasets.preprocessing: answer normalisation following the VQA python API

datasets.name: Open-Ended miniImageNet / Real-Name miniImageNet
datasets.split: ImageNet validation images, miniImageNet class subset S
datasets.source: built from ImageNet; class subset from Ravi & Larochelle
datasets.preprocessing: 224x224; labels replaced with nonsense words (dax, blicket, slation, perpo, shously) or real names

datasets.name: Fast-VQA / Real-Fast-VQA
datasets.source: built from ImageNet (all 1,000 classes) and Visual Genome
datasets.preprocessing: 2-way only; VG questions containing class names filtered, names replaced by dax/blicket

models.name: Frozen 7B LM
models.architecture: GPT-2-like decoder, relative position encodings, pre-trained on C4, frozen

models.name: Vision encoder
models.architecture: NF-ResNet-50, final output after global pooling, linear map to D*n channels reshaped to n embeddings, n=2

training.objective: caption log-likelihood log p(y|x) with LM frozen, gradients through LM into vision encoder
training.batch_size: 128 (per instance 8; 16 synchronous data-parallel replicas; model parallel over 4 accelerators)
training.epochs: early stop, optimum usually just after a single epoch
training.regularisation: early stopping on Conceptual Captions validation perplexity

inference.samples: single greedy sample for quantitative results; qualitative figures curated from about 5 seeds
inference.prompting: interleaved image embeddings and text; 'Question: ... Answer:' for VQA; 'This is a dax.' captions for miniImageNet; optional task-induction text e.g. 'Answer with dax or blicket.'

parameters.shots: 0, 1 and 4 for VQA; inner-shots 1,3,5; repeats 0,1,3,5 for miniImageNet

metrics.name: VQAv2/OKVQA accuracy
metrics.definition: VQA-API normalisation of greedy output vs ground-truth answers

metrics.name: miniImageNet accuracy
metrics.definition: correct only if model generates the right category word then EOS

metrics.name: Fast-VQA exact match
metrics.definition: exact match with the single VG answer after VQAv2 post-processing

eval.protocol: single runs reported; no seeds or intervals stated

availability.data: Evaluation sets promised for the camera-ready version

prompts.text: Question: What colour is the car? Answer:

evidence.quote: constant learning rate of 3e-4 unless otherwise noted
trained on a 4x8 TPUv3 [15] topology for about 12 hours

limits: Far from state-of-the-art on every task; a proof of concept and baseline
Qualitative samples curated from around 5 seeds; fails often by repeating prompt or irrelevant text
Simple prefix and relative positional scheme left unexplored; no seeds or variance for quantitative results
Evaluation datasets not released at the time of the preprint
Training steps, warmup, precision and vision-encoder pretraining not stated
